content: Nnanga sa bẹ anangi afọhnẹja ọmaana ab'aLẹvi
K'odik-ọkka, afọhnẹja p'ẹnọmma cha Lẹvi biphyir, kàkhaambi akhaama ọttọhk f'ode fabẹ, abira atzọkha ekkema k'irerek s'anọng p'Israẹl.
Bẹ ekkema ch'irerek s'ayokh-ammaana pabẹ p'Israẹl, kákhaama. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi wọ ode ekkema chabẹ, mach'okk'ochekhi ọnang bẹ.
K'ogbe kpenamkpen kw'anọng atzim adaam-ogbodo, obiro ode orukhikmaan asi ẹjafọhni, ekkema ch'afọhnẹja ede: amaanggọ, ọmaana akpabhọri ttara atzen-yara p'eho.
Bọng akhaambi anang bẹ icheden-pha s'ekpo pya bọng ayaabh, atzuk abhapẹ ọmaana ana p'oliv, ọmaana icheden-phyubha sa bọng aphyiri k'arukhimaan pabọng.

Da Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng okk'bẹ otzekha ọmaana va pa va pabẹ, ka ngọma sabọng biphyir bi, bẹ atzera nho sabọng, abira asi ọtzọhm ka che ch'Ovaar Ibinọkpaabyi k'ogbe kpenamkpen.
Idikha oLẹvi-nọng kw'orukhi k'obhon manda wani kwabọng m'Israẹl, otzim ettem obungichẹ obina kẹ da orukhi, ochina k'ibe kpenamkpen s'Ovaar Ibinọkpabyi ótzekha,
kẹ ọfha osi ọtzọhm f'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi mach'ayokh-ayok aLẹvi p'am-asi ọtzọhm mẹ, k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
Kẹ ọkhaambi ọtzọkha ekkema ebenga-mbọhk ttara ayokh-oyok aLẹvi, kaambi ode kẹ okk'ekkema ọtzọkha k'agbikha pa bẹ akpe efonakpo.
Ẹtzọhng-dọra ch'ikha ọtzatzaam
“Mada bọng apyiri k'irerek nna s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng ọnangi bọng, bọng kàkhaambi atzaam akha-tzama p'idibhon nnuma.

Tte ọnọng manda wani oningi k'ottem kwabọng ode, kw'ọtzọkha nnwa kwẹ kw'ijinọng obiro ode kw'ikwanọng otzima ọfọhni ẹja k'ekpon ẹwọmachẹ. Ọnọng kw'ọbhari abọhkpakpa, kaambi ose wọ, obiro ode mbọng, ọmaana itzatzaana-dik,
kaambi ọnọng kw'ọm-ọbhari anọng ikhọmana wọ, obiro ode ochikpakpaa, obiro ode ọnọng kw'ọm-ọdọhn apfuranọng, oningi k'ottem kwabọng ode.
Ọnọng kw'osi idik nna, okpukhi Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi idik. Idik nna rani rọ isi Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng ókhubh idibhon nnuma kẹ da bọng akkeri itzitzikha.
Bọng akhaambi akhonga aruk akpen p'abari ayọhnga ottotto k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kwode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng.
Asẹjaakhi p'odik-ọkka ọmaana p'ibhora

Kaambi ode bi, idibhon sa bọng átza abọkha obe ana, im-iyonga itzọnhg inang abọhnga-nọng ọmaana anọng p'abhari abọhkpakpa, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kwode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, bọbọng ẹfa dema nduma kọnangi.

Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kwode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, ọ́rọbha ọsẹjaakhi ọrọbha ka bọng k'ottem, kw'óde macha kaam kw'obiro ofona m'ottem kwa bọbọng anọng p'Israẹl. Bọng akhaambi ayonga itzọhng anang-ẹ.

Odik kw'iwa bọng aphyemi Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kwode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng ka Horẹb wọ ma, k'ewu ch'iwa bọng atzobh, abhom aben bi, “Tte moningi ẹmọng ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kwode Ibinọkpaabyi kwaman, dọk ọbhaang e, moningi ekpon-barada nda dọk ore e, oni mando ode, mópe-ope e.”
Wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben-m bi, “Odik kwabẹ aphyemi ojibhi kẹ.

Kaam nnọbha ọsẹjaakhi k'ottem p'anọng p'Israẹl ọrọbha, kw'ode macha kọ nnang bẹ. Kaam mbiri ńge atzim paam k'ẹmma chẹ p'ọgbaak. Kẹ ósi ẹjaakhi ch'odik kpenamkpen kwa ndọhn-ẹ, ọ́nang bẹ.
Kaam ọkhaam wọ nttọhna aponga p'ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'oni itzọhng oyong ọnang atzim paam, p'ọsẹjaakhi otzim che chaam ọgbaak bẹ.
Yina, ọsẹjaakhi kw'otzim che chaam ọgbaak odik kwa kaam nnẹ-ẹ mgbaakhi, obiro ode ọsẹjaakhi kw'otzim che p'ikha osi ẹjaakhi, bẹ akhaambi afhẹ-ẹ.”
Asi mẹ, bọng am-abọbh bi, “Mosi yan oronga ẹkkaabha ch'eni k'Ovaar Ibinọkpaabyi efon o?”

Idikha odik nwuma kw'ọsẹjaakhi otzim che ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi osi ẹjaakhi on-otto, ode bi kwẹ kobiro ode mach'ọgbaakhi, kw'oyini bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi odik nwuma kọgbaakhi. Ọsẹjaakhi nwuma otzim ẹfa osi ẹjaakhi nduma e, mẹ wọ, opoma oningi bọng osi.
